[SWS_CM_00812] Behavior of
ara::com
when unsubscribing from an event
⌈
After calling
Unsubscribe()
by
ara::com
at the proxy side, there shall be no
active subscription to the event and therefore no event shall be delivered to the ap-
plication (i.e. no event receive handler [SWS_CM_10296] shall be called). Calling
Unsubscribe()
shall clear the queue of delivered samples for the event (see chap-
ter 7.5.22.2).
⌋
7.5.14 Receive event
For the event data access C++ API reference, see chapter 8.3.2.2.3.2 and 8.3.2.2.3.1.
